fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.
fields.description2: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
fields.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110 to 150}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*2 to 150*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
fields.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
fields.description4: ''Whirling Death'' deals {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}} damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
fields.description5: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
